scripts.build: npm run build-test && npm run clean-prod
scripts.build-test: npm run clean-build && npx tsc && npm run copy-files
scripts.test: npm run build-test && node --test ./dist/test/**/*.js && npm run integration-test
scripts.integration-test: npm run build-test && REDIS_DRIVER=node-redis node --test ./dist/integration-tests/**/*.js && REDIS_DRIVER=ioredis node --test ./dist/integration-tests/**/*.js && REDIS_DRIVER=node-test-driver node --test ./dist/integration-tests/**/*.js
